EXPLORER.  It had  been  interrupted  because  of  the  higher  priority  of  the  LHC  cost overrun discussions.   The  Research  Board  agreed  to  restart  this  procedure  starting  with L3+C at the next Research Board.

The next meeting of the Research Board will take place on

Thursday,  12  September  2002.

## ENCLOSURES

- [1] Minutes of the 12 th INTC meeting held on 13 May 2002 (INTC 2002-026/INTC 12)
- [2] Minutes of the 58 th LHCC meeting held on 15-16 May 2002 (LHCC 2002-019/LHCC 58)
- [3] Minutes of the 58 th SPSC meeting held on 21 May 2002 (SPSC 2002-022/SPSC 58)

## REFERENCES

- [ 1] Minutes of the 157 th meeting of the Research Board held on 11 March 2002 (CERN/DG/RB 2001-332, M157)
- [ 2] Minutes of the 158 th meeting of the Research Board held on 11 April 2002 (CERN/DG/RB 2001-335, M158)
- [ 3] Neutron Cross Sections for the Pb Isotopes Implications for ADS and Nucleosynthesis (INTC 2001-020/P142)
- [ 4] Measurements of fission cross sections for the isotopes relevant to the Thorium fuel cycle (INTC 2001-025/P145)
- [ 5] Measurement of the neutron capture cross sections of 232 Th, 231 Pa, 234 U and 236 U; (INTC 2002-013/P154)
- [ 6] An Energy Upgrade of REX-Isolde to 3.1 MeV/u and Acceleration of Heavier Masses up to A=150 (INTC 2002-009/P152)
- [ 7] Fusion Reactions at the Coulomb Barrier with Neutron-rich Mg Isotopes (INTC 2002014/P155)
- [ 8] Evolution of single particle and collective properties in the neutron-rich Mg isotopes (INTC 2002-020/P159)
- [ 9] Summary, plan and resources of RD39 projects (LHCC 2002-015, Status Report/ RD39 1)
- [10] Development of radiation hard semiconductor devices for very high luminosity colliders (LHCC 2002-003/P6)
- [11] Status Report on the NA60 Pixel Detector Project (SPSC 2002-024/M689)
- [12] Status Report of the HARP experiment (SPSC 2002-019/M685)
- [13] Future plans; The DIRAC Collaboration (SPSC 2002-018/M684)
